text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. Wonder Acute 
receives cheers from her juniors: 
Tomakomai's local idol, Hokko Tarumae, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From the Feng Shui Umamusume, Copano 
Rickey. "Let's train super hard for the 
Japan Dirt Derby!"
